description: Use this when finance or an auditor asks for signed evidence by fetching the proof packet for a known dossier UUID in the environment-bound organization. The tool is read-only, performs no marketplace action, and never treats successful verification as permission to execute.

dossier_id.description: UUID returned by commercegate_evaluate_action or a shadow report.

name: commercegate_get_proof_packet
title: Get a CommerceGate Proof Packet
